title: Courtside Phase II
address:
1600 NW 3rd Ave
Miami, Florida 33136
United States
description:
Courtside Phase II is a $39,685,091 affordable housing development in Miami's historic Overtown neighborhood. Two five-story buildings, totaling 191,155 square feet, hold 120 apartments and 154 parking spaces.

The community's amenities include a clubhouse with a media center, a fitness center, a dog park, and bike storage.
